verdict.rationale: Datalab documents general document conversion, schema-based field extraction with bounding-box citations, and redline/comment extraction from scans. None of the evidence mentions handwriting recognition or confidence flags for uncertain extractions. Bounding-box citations and track-changes extraction are adjacent features, not handwritten-field recognition with uncertainty scoring.

support.subject: As a developer, handwritten fields and annotations are recognized and extracted, flagged with confidence when uncertain
